b = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Calculate the initial sum of absolute differences
initial_sum = sum(abs(a_i - b_i) for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b))

# Calculate the difference array
diff = [a_i - b_i for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b)]

# Find the maximum absolute difference that can be reduced by swapping
max_diff = max(abs(x) for x in diff)

# The minimum possible sum is the initial sum minus twice the maximum absolute difference
# if we can reduce the sum by swapping two elements
min_sum = initial_sum - 2 * max_diff if max_diff > 0 else initial_sum

print(min_sum)
